name: Terry Davis: To Be a King, You Have to Go Insane
aliases: to be a king you have to go insane
description: Terry Davis in a backwards cap, filming in the back of his van: "To be a king, you gotta let go through insanity. You have to go insane. When you conquer, to be a king, you have to go insane."
usage: The price of greatness. Justifying an obsessive project, a crunch, or doing something no sane person would.

source.author: @Davisanism
source.example: “To be a king, you have to go insane.”
